items.title: Payment Infrastructure
items.description: We are certified integrators. We guide your institution from onboarding with Banco de México through to production, with high-availability schemes and 24/7 monitoring.

items.title: Cryptography and Data Protection
items.description: We implement Thales Luna 700 HSMs, full cryptographic key lifecycle management, and reinforced authentication. Compliant with FIPS 140-2 Level 3

items.title: Sovereign Infrastructure and Hybrid Cloud
items.description: On-premise, private and hybrid cloud architecture with guaranteed data residency in Mexico. No dependency on foreign hyperscalers — you control where your data resides

items.title: Managed Services
items.description: Continuous operation and monitoring of critical infrastructure (HSM, SPEI, cloud). Includes architecture consulting, implementation, NOC/SOC support, and technical training for internal teams.

items.title: Regulatory Compliance
items.description: Compliance with CNBV regulations, operational continuity, and security requirements for Mexican financial institutions.
